description: Provisioning units of an app (ADR-0048 section 2). Generated: python3 infra/tests/check-infra.py --update-units (core CI fails when stale). fingerprint = sha256 of the unit's compiled templates (_generator metadata removed, canonical JSON), its .bicepparam files and its revision, each part length-prefixed. Edit only `revision`, by hand, when a script changes what the unit does in Azure while its template and inputs stay the same. since = the core version since which the fingerprint is unchanged; `unreleased` until tools/scripts/release-units.mjs <version> at release time.
